sessions_mode_fields.name: sessions_mode_fields
sessions_mode_fields.value: ("sessions"."mode" = 'online' or "sessions"."location" is not null) and ("sessions"."mode" = 'offline' or "sessions"."meeting_url" is not null)

fee_schedules_due.name: fee_schedules_due
fee_schedules_due.value: ("fee_schedules"."period" = 'monthly' and "fee_schedules"."due_day" between 1 and 28) or ("fee_schedules"."period" = 'once' and "fee_schedules"."due_on" is not null)
